Documentation: Fired when the state of an addon restriction type is changing. This event is sequenced such that it will always be fired before a restriction becomes active, or after it is deactivated.
ADDON_RESTRICTION_STATE_CHANGED.Name: AddonRestrictionStateChanged

Documentation: Expects a base spell, so if a spell is overridden the base ID should be provided.
Arguments.Name: spellID

Documentation: Returns the list of action bar slots that contain a specified spell.
C_ActionBar.FindSpellActionButtons.Name: FindSpellActionButtons

Documentation: Returns a duration object describing the active cooldown duration for an action.
C_ActionBar.GetActionCooldownDuration.Name: GetActionCooldownDuration

Documentation: Returns the current state of an addon restriction type.
C_RestrictedActions.GetAddOnRestrictionS.Name: GetAddOnRestrictionState

Documentation: Queries the base secrecy for a spell if queried as an aura.
C_Secrets.GetSpellAuraSecrecy.Name: GetSpellAuraSecrecy

Documentation: Queries the base secrecy for a spell if queried as a cooldown.
C_Secrets.GetSpellCooldownSecrecy.Name: GetSpellCooldownSecrecy

Documentation: Returns true if a given spell identifier would, if applied as an aura, produce secret values when queried.
C_Secrets.ShouldSpellAuraBeSecret.Name: ShouldSpellAuraBeSecret

Documentation: Returns true if a given spell identifier will produce secret values for cooldowns if queried.
C_Secrets.ShouldSpellCooldownBeSecret.Name: ShouldSpellCooldownBeSecret

Documentation: Returns true if queries for unit power will produce secret values.
C_Secrets.ShouldUnitPowerBeSecret.Name: ShouldUnitPowerBeSecret

Documentation: Which Class Specialization to consider, as overrides may vary by Spec; Defaults to player's current Spec
Arguments.Name: spec

Documentation: Returns the spellID passed in if there is no override
Returns.Name: overrideSpellID

Documentation: Returns a table of info about the charges of a charge-accumulating spell; May return nil if spell is not found or is not charge-based
C_Spell.GetSpellCharges.Name: GetSpellCharges

Documentation: Returns nil if spell is not found
C_Spell.GetSpellCooldown.Name: GetSpellCooldown

Documentation: Returns a duration object describing the active cooldown duration for a spell.
C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownDuration.Name: GetSpellCooldownDuration

Documentation: Returns nil if spell is not found
C_Spell.GetSpellName.Name: GetSpellName

Documentation: Returns a table containing one or more SpellPowerCostInfos, one for each power type this spell costs; May return nil if spell is not found or has no resource costs
C_Spell.GetSpellPowerCost.Name: GetSpellPowerCost

Documentation: Optional specific target; If not supplied, player's current target (if any) will be used
Arguments.Name: targetUnit

Documentation: Returns true if the current target is within range of the spell; False if out of range; Nil if range check was invalid
C_Spell.IsSpellInRange.Name: IsSpellInRange

Documentation: May be nil if the range check was invalid, ie due to unknown/invalid spell, missing/invalid target, etc
Returns.Name: inRange

Documentation: Returns whether the spell is currently castable; Typically based on things like learned status, required resources, etc
C_Spell.IsSpellUsable.Name: IsSpellUsable

Documentation: True if spell is specifically unusable due to insufficient power (ie MANA, RAGE, etc)
Returns.Name: insufficientPower

Documentation: Can be a base spell or an override spell. A nil value indicates that all cooldowns should be updated, rather than just a specific one.
Payload.Name: spellID

Documentation: Will be set to the base spell if the spellID parameter is an override spell.
Payload.Name: baseSpellID

Documentation: If the spellID parameter is set, the cooldown category of the spell. A nil value indicates the spell does not have a cooldown category.
Payload.Name: category

Documentation: If the spellID parameter is set, the cooldown start recovery category of the spell. A nil value indicates the spell does not have a cooldown start recovery category.
Payload.Name: startRecoveryCategory

Documentation: If the itemID parameter is set, it's the itemID associated with the cast of the spell.
Payload.Name: itemID

Documentation: Returns percent of health remaining - can be scaled via a curve for display purposes
UnitHealthPercent.Name: UnitHealthPercent

Documentation: If no curve is specified, a floating point percentage value. Else, the result of evaluating the curve with the percentage as the input.
Returns.Name: result

Documentation: Returns true if the immediate calling function has appropriate permissions to access and operate on a specific value.
canaccessvalue.Name: canaccessvalue

Documentation: Returns true if a supplied value is a secret value.
issecretvalue.Name: issecretvalue
